items.title: Common AI Applications (e.g., voice assistants, chatbots, image recognition) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Common AI Applications (e.g., voice assistants, chatbots, image recognition) (PDF 108, printed 104).

blocks.text: AI bohat se tools aur services mein maujood hai jo log roz use karte hain. Siri, Alexa aur Google Assistant jaise voice assistants boli hui hidayat samajh kar mufeed maloomat dete ya kaam karte hain. Websites par chatbots sawalon ke jawab de kar gahakon ki madad karte hain, aur image recognition systems tasveeron aur scans se chehre, cheezein ya beemariyan pehchante hain. YouTube, Daraz aur Amazon jaise platforms ke recommendation systems bhi AI use karte hain jo user ki pasand ke mutabiq videos ya products suggest karte hain. Transport mein self-driving gariyan AI se apne ird-gird ko samajh kar mehfooz driving ke faisle karti hain. Yeh istemal technology ko zyada interactive, kaar-amad aur user ke mutabiq bante hain, aur taqreeban har digital service mein zaati (personalized) tajurba dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan platform ka naam 'Draz' chhapti hai; sahi naam Daraz hai, jaise kitab agle hisse mein khud likhti hai.

blocks.prompt: YouTube par aap cricket ki videos dekhte hain aur agle din aap ko aur cricket videos suggest hoti hain. Yeh AI ka kaun sa istemal hai?
blocks.explanation: Recommendation system: AI user ki pasand (preferences) dekh kar milti julti videos ya products suggest karti hai, jaise YouTube, Daraz aur Amazon par.

items: Voice assistants, chatbots, image recognition, recommendation systems aur self-driving cars AI ke aam istemal hain.
Yeh technology ko interactive aur har user ke mutabiq (personalized) banate hain.
